snapshots.method: At each fixed tau bracket, retain previous and next native cell-centered profiles p,q,m,C and alpha/a; linear interpolation in proper time without fitting. No extrapolation: late snapshots beyond any run support are explicitly missing, not silently dropped. First ten windows mandatory; final two late diagnostics. Compare common physical radii on intersection of native grids (coarsest center to last coarsest center), 12288 points at coarse centers; separate near-origin dense audit on common support r<=.5 using coarse centers, and local peak neighborhood. Report maximum over full profile and inner region; no extrapolation to origin or outer face.

peak.native: record all integration steps argmax radius, top distinct local maxima, gap between largest two; local maxima determined by neighbor comparisons, ties deterministic leftmost, exclude boundary endpoints from quadratic fits
peak.subcell: three-point quadratic vertex only if concave and vertex inside adjacent centers; otherwise native value flagged invalid. Diagnostic only, no replacement of original peak gate.
peak.shift: abs(rmax_i-rmax_j)>h_coarser flags shift; report shift in both grid units. Shift alone is not proof of branch switching. Competing branch diagnostic: two separated local maxima (>2*h_coarser) with gap <=.0005; report locations and relative heights; compare nearest candidates across grids; no post hoc threshold selection.
peak.metrics: separate native max, maximum interpolated on common physical grid, subcell fitted max; decompose signed native peak difference into common-grid peak difference plus differences of sampling increments; also compare same-radius C at both native peak locations where supported.

profile.diagnostics: full and inner C/m profiles on common radii; common radius differences and observed L2/Linf orders; same radius peak neighborhood; compare both pairs, medium-fine thresholds; peak gate retained unchanged; if profile fails cannot blame argmax only

synthetic_mass.analytic: constant density mass m=k*r^3, C=2*k*r^2, k=.002, R=4; choose p=sqrt(3*k/(2*pi*(1-2*k*r^2))), q=0 to solve same radial constraint; test original geometry against analytic center mass and C, grids 256/512/1024. Also analytic smooth isolated C peak and two competing peaks, test native and quadratic peak reconstruction on known functions, no solver modification.
synthetic_mass.criteria: C analytic Linf <=.0005 on finest and observed order 1.5–2.5; record mass errors and order; analytic interpolation of m versus direct C separate, quadratic synthetic peak errors and validity; synthetic pass not physical validation

crossing.quadratic: three native samples ending at first crossing i (i-2,i-1,i), fit polynomial in shifted/scaled tau; require finite unique real root inside historical bracket and positive derivative; otherwise unresolved, no substitute. Compare event tau, slope dC/dtau, local peak slope, interpolation difference and cross-grid error ratio. Compute order and monotonicity for both. Sign reversal or >.5 order shift is estimator sensitivity, not proof ill-conditioning; report local inverse-slope condition and C error/slope prediction as first-order diagnostic only.
crossing.late: Evaluate Ricci at both interpolated crossing times via linear interpolation of Ricci on each native trajectory. Compare also fixed common tau before late crossing, decompose event-time contribution vs common-support difference using exact signed algebra; no causal claim from decomposition alone.

replay.mode: original artifact available; verify ZIP SHA256 and exact all 19-column native trace bytes for each of three spatial runs before interpreting new profiles. No fallback, no changed environment claim.
replay.safety: unchanged solver and thresholds; numeric gates same as R4B5A.3; compare prefix .85 and full .90 historical trace; if mismatch technical hold; no scientific diagnosis from mismatched replay.

budget.priority: synthetic, coarse, medium, fine; check projected fine=4*medium runtime before launching; partial evidence retained

claim_ceiling: diagnostic localization only; separate fixed-time C, event-time and late Ricci holds; never declare resolution from improved diagnostic estimator alone
